observations.note: Properties this audit examined that did not warrant a finding. They are recorded because an audit that reports only its verdict hides what it looked at, and because a later run may want to decide differently.

observations.subject: the passing test count is environment dependent by one case
observations.observed: The subject records 363 passing cases. Reproducing the suite from a clean clone detached at the subject tag gives 363 run, 362 passed, 0 failures, 0 errors and 1 conditional skip: AuditAttestationModelTests.test_an_unsealed_subject_is_rejected, whose own guard says every checkpoint directory in a fully sealed checkout is sealed. In the working repository of this audit a different case skips for the same kind of reason, PreflightFreshnessTests.test_the_preflight_of_the_current_delivery_is_fresh, because the audit checkpoint already existed and carried no preflight yet.
observations.assessment: Not a finding. Both skips are conditional guards on repository state, the delivery measured its own environment where neither condition held, and RESUME-VALIDATION.md makes no numeric claim about a clean clone. The suite is green in both environments with zero failures and zero errors.
observations.wouldBecomeAFindingIf: a checkpoint claimed a passing count for an environment it did not measure, or a skip were counted as a pass in the environment where it occurred

observations.subject: a narrative sentence about adversarial categories is looser than the artifact it summarises
observations.observed: FINAL-REPORT.md of the subject writes: mandatory battery 26; additional battery 30; attestation scenarios 14; positive controls 2, followed by the sentence that the categories do not overlap and each is derived. AFFECTED-RED-TEAM.json shows that the 14 attestation scenarios are a labelled view over the executed battery and share members with both batteries, and its own description says so. The derived total, 56, equals 26 plus 30 and double counts nothing.
observations.assessment: Not a finding. The numbers are derived and the total is correct; the machine-readable artifact describes the attestation category accurately as the surface this delivery changed rather than as a disjoint partition. The prose is a loose summary of an accurate artifact, and no count contradicts the derivation.
observations.wouldBecomeAFindingIf: the total were computed by adding the four figures, or an artifact asserted disjointness that its own membership contradicts

observations.subject: three refusal branches of the attestation model have no test
observations.observed: verify_attestation refuses an audit checkpoint that exists but is not sealed, an audit checkpoint absent from the integrity chain, and a subject commit that is not an ancestor of the audit commit, all on the third-party derivation path. No case in the suite exercises those three branches. This audit exercised them directly and each refused with the expected message.
observations.assessment: Not a finding, and not a regression. The test the corrective delivery removed was named after the unsealed-auditor case but actually asserted the does-not-exist case, and its replacement asserts the same thing under an accurate name, so no assertion was lost. The branches were uncovered before this delivery as well.
observations.wouldBecomeAFindingIf: one of those branches stopped refusing, which this audit checked by execution rather than by reading

observations.subject: the prose-count control is scoped to scripts and tests
observations.observed: The control of CP9-F-003 inspects the comments and docstrings of Python sources under scripts and tests. A harness kept inside a checkpoint directory, including the harness of this audit, is outside it.
observations.assessment: Not a finding. docs/QUALITY-GATES.md records the scope explicitly as a decision, which is what the acceptance criteria of CP9-F-003 asked for, and checkpoint Markdown is covered by the separate derived-count comparison. The scope is disclosed rather than assumed.
observations.wouldBecomeAFindingIf: the scope were narrowed without the policy being narrowed with it

observations.subject: the trust model of a milestone verdict is structural, not cryptographic
observations.observed: A verdict requires a second sealed, tagged, anchored checkpoint authored as the audit of an already sealed subject. There is no signature and no external key, so an actor who can create that checkpoint and its tag can forge the relationship.
observations.assessment: Not a finding. The limit is stated in docs/MILESTONE-VALIDATION.md, in .iacode/attestations/README.md and in the trust model of the anchor chain, and no artifact claims more than that. This audit confirms the claim is not overstated anywhere it is made.
observations.wouldBecomeAFindingIf: any artifact described the control as cryptographic assurance
